list_agents.title: List agents
list_agents.description: Every agent (CustomGPT calls them projects) on the account, with its id, name and indexing state. The project id this returns is what almost every other tool here takes.

page.description: Which page of agents to return.

width.description: Chat widget width to report in the response.

height.description: Chat widget height to report in the response.

name.description: Filter to agents whose name matches this text.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_agent.title: Create an agent
create_agent.description: Create a new agent from a sitemap url or an uploaded file. Indexing runs asynchronously afterwards, so the agent is not answerable until its `is_chat_active` flag flips -- poll get_agent rather than chatting immediately.

attributes.description: The agent to create -- `project_name` plus one of `sitemap_path` or `file_data_retension`, and the optional model and behaviour settings.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_agent.title: Get an agent
get_agent.description: One agent's details, including whether indexing has finished and the agent is ready to answer questions. This is the flag to poll after create_agent.

output.description: The requested record.

update_agent.title: Update an agent
update_agent.description: Change an agent's name, sitemap or core configuration. A POST, not a PATCH -- CustomGPT uses POST for updates throughout. Changing the sitemap triggers a re-index.

attributes.description: The agent fields to change, e.g. `project_name` or `sitemap_path`.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

delete_agent.title: Delete an agent
delete_agent.description: Delete an agent along with its indexed documents and conversation history. Irreversible, and it takes every conversation and citation with it.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

replicate_agent.title: Replicate an agent
replicate_agent.description: Copy an agent, its settings and its sources into a new agent. The safe way to try a settings or persona change without disturbing an agent that is live in front of customers.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_agent_stats.title: Get agent statistics
get_agent_stats.description: Indexing and usage counters for one agent -- how many pages are indexed, how many failed, how many queries it has answered. The first place to look when an agent is answering "I don't know".

output.description: The requested record.

list_child_agents.title: List child agents
list_child_agents.description: The agents assigned as children of this one. Child agents let a parent route a question to a specialised agent instead of answering from one large index.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

assign_child_agents.title: Assign child agents
assign_child_agents.description: Attach one or more agents as children of this one, so the parent can route questions to them.

attributes.description: The child agents to assign, as the ids the reference documents.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

unassign_child_agents.title: Unassign all child agents
unassign_child_agents.description: Detach every child agent from this one in a single call. The children themselves are not deleted -- only the routing relationship goes.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

unassign_child_agent.title: Unassign one child agent
unassign_child_agent.description: Detach a single child agent from its parent, leaving the other children in place. The child agent itself survives.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

get_agent_settings.title: Get agent settings
get_agent_settings.description: The agent's full behaviour and appearance configuration -- persona, model, response source, citation display, chat widget styling and language.

output.description: The requested record.

update_agent_settings.title: Update agent settings
update_agent_settings.description: Change an agent's behaviour or appearance. This is where the persona prompt, the model, `response_source` and citation visibility live -- the settings that decide how the agent answers.

attributes.description: The settings fields to change, e.g. `chatbot_model`, `persona_instructions`, `response_source`.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

list_persona_versions.title: List persona versions
list_persona_versions.description: Every saved version of the agent's persona prompt. Personas are versioned, so a prompt change can be rolled back rather than rewritten from memory.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_persona_version.title: Get a persona version
get_persona_version.description: One saved persona version in full, so a previous prompt can be read before deciding whether to reactivate it.

output.description: The requested record.

activate_persona_version.title: Activate a persona version
activate_persona_version.description: Make a saved persona version the live one. Takes effect on the next question the agent answers, so it changes customer-facing behaviour immediately.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_sub_personas.title: List sub-personas
list_sub_personas.description: The sub-personas defined on one persona version. Sub-personas override the base prompt for a particular topic or audience without forking the whole persona.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

update_sub_persona.title: Update a sub-persona override
update_sub_persona.description: Change one sub-persona's override on a persona version, leaving the base prompt and the other sub-personas untouched.

attributes.description: The sub-persona fields to change.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_sub_persona.title: Delete a sub-persona override
delete_sub_persona.description: Remove a sub-persona override so questions in its area fall back to the base persona prompt.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

get_deployment_settings.title: Get deployment settings
get_deployment_settings.description: How the agent is exposed -- the embed widget, the shareable link, the livechat integration and the domains allowed to load it.

output.description: The requested record.

update_deployment_settings.title: Update deployment settings
update_deployment_settings.description: Change one section of the deployment settings. Note this governs who can reach the agent from the public internet, so widening the allowed domains is a security-relevant change.

section.description: Which section of the deployment settings to update.

attributes.description: The fields to change within that deployment section.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_documents.title: List an agent's documents
list_documents.description: The pages and files indexed into one agent, with each one's crawl and index status. `crawl_status` and `index_status` are what explain a source that the agent never cites.

page.description: Which page of documents to return.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

delete_document.title: Delete a document
delete_document.description: Remove one document from the agent's index. The agent stops citing it on the next question; existing conversations keep their old citations.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

reindex_document.title: Reindex a document
reindex_document.description: Re-crawl and re-embed one document. The fix for a page whose content changed, or one that failed indexing the first time.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_document_labels.title: Get a document's labels
get_document_labels.description: The labels attached to one document. Labels are how retrieval is scoped to a subset of the index for a particular user or audience.

output.description: The requested record.

replace_document_labels.title: Replace a document's labels
replace_document_labels.description: Set a document's labels wholesale. Anything not in the payload is removed, so send the complete list rather than the additions.

attributes.description: The full replacement label list for the document.

output.description: The record after the update.

get_document_metadata.title: Get a document's metadata
get_document_metadata.description: The title, url, description and custom metadata stored against one document -- what the agent shows alongside a citation.

output.description: The requested record.

update_document_metadata.title: Update a document's metadata
update_document_metadata.description: Change the title, url or description a document is cited under, without re-crawling its content.

attributes.description: The metadata fields to set on the document.

output.description: The record after the update.

get_citation_source_preview.title: Get a citation source preview
get_citation_source_preview.description: A preview of the source behind a citation, for showing users what a cited document contains without exposing the underlying file.

output.description: The requested record.

list_sources.title: List an agent's sources
list_sources.description: The sitemaps, uploads and connected integrations feeding one agent's index, with each one's sync settings and last run.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

add_source.title: Add a source
add_source.description: Attach a new source -- a sitemap, a url or a connected integration -- to an agent. Indexing starts asynchronously, so the content is not answerable straight away.

attributes.description: The source to add, e.g. `sitemap_path` or the integration's configuration.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_source.title: Update a source's settings
update_source.description: Change one source's sync schedule or configuration. A PUT, so send the complete settings object rather than only the changed field.

attributes.description: The full replacement settings for the source.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_source.title: Delete a source
delete_source.description: Remove a source and the documents it contributed from the agent's index. The agent loses everything that source supplied.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

sync_source.title: Trigger an instant source sync
sync_source.description: Re-sync one source immediately instead of waiting for its schedule. The way to pick up content that changed since the last scheduled crawl.

attributes.description: Sync options, where the source type accepts any.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_context_pages.title: List webpage context pages
list_context_pages.description: The pages held as webpage context for contextual RAG -- content the agent reads as page-level context rather than as retrieved chunks.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

delete_context_pages.title: Delete webpage context pages
delete_context_pages.description: Remove webpage context pages from the agent. The agent stops using them as page context on the next question.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

bulk_update_context_messages.title: Bulk update page messages
bulk_update_context_messages.description: Update the contextual RAG messages for many pages at once, rather than one call per page.

attributes.description: The page-message updates to apply.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_conversations.title: List conversations
list_conversations.description: The conversations held with one agent, with their session ids and metadata. The session id is what every message tool below takes.

page.description: Which page of conversations to return.

user_filter.description: Restrict to conversations belonging to one user.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_conversation.title: Create a conversation
create_conversation.description: Open a new conversation with an agent and get back the session id that send_message needs. Every exchange belongs to a conversation; there is no stateless chat endpoint apart from the OpenAI-compatible one.

attributes.description: The conversation to create, e.g. its `name` and an `external_id` linking it to your own system.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_conversation.title: Update a conversation
update_conversation.description: Rename a conversation or change the metadata stored against it. Does not alter the messages it holds.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

attributes.description: The conversation fields to change.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_conversation.title: Delete a conversation
delete_conversation.description: Delete a conversation and every message in it. Irreversible, and it removes the record an analytics report was built from.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

export_conversation.title: Export a conversation
export_conversation.description: Export one conversation's full transcript, for archiving or for review outside the CustomGPT dashboard.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_conversation_messages.title: Get a conversation's messages
get_conversation_messages.description: The messages in one conversation, each with the agent's answer and the citations it drew on. The `citations` ids here are what get_citation takes.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

page.description: Which page of messages to return.

output.description: The requested record.

send_message.title: Send a message
send_message.description: Ask the agent a question inside a conversation and get its answer plus citations. This is the main call the whole product exists for. Set `stream` false unless the caller can consume server-sent events.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

stream.description: Stream the answer as SSE instead of returning one body.

attributes.description: The message -- `prompt` for the question, plus optional `custom_persona`, `response_source` and `chatbot_model` overrides.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

send_chat_completion.title: Send a message (OpenAI format)
send_chat_completion.description: Ask the agent a question using the OpenAI chat-completions request and response shape, so an existing OpenAI client can point at CustomGPT with only a base-url change. Same retrieval behind it as send_message.

attributes.description: An OpenAI-shaped chat completion request -- `messages`, and optionally `stream` and `model`.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_message.title: Get one message
get_message.description: A single message in a conversation, with its answer, citations and metadata. Narrower than paging the whole conversation when you already have the prompt id.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

prompt_id.description: The message's prompt id, from get_conversation_messages.

output.description: The requested record.

update_message_feedback.title: Record feedback on a message
update_message_feedback.description: Record a thumbs-up or thumbs-down on one answer. Feedback feeds the analytics reports, which is how a badly-performing agent shows up.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

prompt_id.description: The message's prompt id, from get_conversation_messages.

attributes.description: The feedback to record, e.g. `reaction`.

output.description: The record after the update.

get_message_claims.title: Get a message's claims
get_message_claims.description: The individual factual claims CustomGPT extracted from one answer, each tied to the source it came from. The building block behind the trust score.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

prompt_id.description: The message's prompt id, from get_conversation_messages.

output.description: The requested record.

get_message_trust_score.title: Get a message's trust score
get_message_trust_score.description: CustomGPT's confidence that an answer is grounded in the agent's sources. A low score is the signal that an answer drifted beyond what the index supports.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

prompt_id.description: The message's prompt id, from get_conversation_messages.

output.description: The requested record.

verify_message.title: Verify a message's accuracy
verify_message.description: Run CustomGPT's accuracy check over one answer, re-testing its claims against the agent's sources. Use it on answers a trust score has already flagged.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

prompt_id.description: The message's prompt id, from get_conversation_messages.

attributes.description: Verification options, where the endpoint accepts any.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_citation.title: Get a citation's metadata
get_citation.description: The document behind one citation -- its title, url and page. This is how a citation id from an answer becomes something a user can click.

citation_id.description: The citation id, taken from a message's `citations` array.

output.description: The requested record.

list_tasks.title: List tasks
list_tasks.description: The agentic tasks running or completed on one agent. A task is a longer-running job than a chat message, with its own message thread and file output.

page.description: Which page of tasks to return.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_task.title: Create a task
create_task.description: Start an agentic task on an agent. Tasks run asynchronously -- poll poll_task until it reports completion rather than expecting an answer in this response.

attributes.description: The task to run, e.g. its `prompt` and any tools it may call.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

poll_task.title: Poll a task
poll_task.description: One task's current state and result. Poll this after create_task; a task that requires a tool call reports that here and waits for submit_tool_outputs.

output.description: The requested record.

update_task.title: Update a task
update_task.description: Change a task's configuration or metadata while it is still open.

attributes.description: The task fields to change.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_task.title: Delete a task
delete_task.description: Delete a task and its message thread. Any files the task produced go with it.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

export_task.title: Export a task
export_task.description: Export a task's full thread and output, for archiving or review outside CustomGPT.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

list_task_messages.title: List a task's messages
list_task_messages.description: The message thread inside one task -- the agent's reasoning steps, tool calls and answers as the task progressed.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

send_task_message.title: Send a follow-up message to a task
send_task_message.description: Add a follow-up instruction to a running task, so it continues with new direction rather than being restarted.

attributes.description: The follow-up message, e.g. its `prompt`.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_task_message.title: Get one task message
get_task_message.description: A single message from a task's thread, with its content and any files or tool calls attached to it.

prompt_history_id.description: The task message's prompt history id.

output.description: The requested record.

submit_tool_outputs.title: Submit tool outputs to a task
submit_tool_outputs.description: Return the results of the tool calls a task asked for, so it can carry on. A task that reported a pending tool call stays blocked until this arrives.

attributes.description: The tool outputs, keyed to the tool call ids the task reported.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

list_task_message_files.title: List a task message's files
list_task_message_files.description: The files attached to one task message -- what the task produced or was given at that step.

prompt_history_id.description: The task message's prompt history id.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

download_task_message_file.title: Download a task message's file
download_task_message_file.description: Fetch the contents of one file attached to a task message. Returns the file itself rather than JSON.

prompt_history_id.description: The task message's prompt history id.

file_id.description: The file id attached to a task message.

output.description: The requested record.

delete_task_message_file.title: Delete a task message's file
delete_task_message_file.description: Permanently remove one file from a task message. The task's thread keeps the message; only the attachment goes.

prompt_history_id.description: The task message's prompt history id.

file_id.description: The file id attached to a task message.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_agent_actions.title: List an agent's actions
list_agent_actions.description: The built-in and custom actions an agent may call while answering -- CustomGPT's tool surface, including MCP-backed custom actions.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_custom_action.title: Create a custom action (MCP)
create_custom_action.description: Register a custom action, typically backed by an MCP server, so the agent can call an external system while answering. The agent gains a new capability the moment this succeeds.

attributes.description: The action definition, including its MCP server configuration.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_custom_action.title: Update a custom action
update_custom_action.description: Change a custom action's configuration. A PUT, so send the complete definition rather than only the changed field.

attributes.description: The full replacement action definition.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_custom_action.title: Delete a custom action
delete_custom_action.description: Remove a custom action from the agent. The agent loses that capability immediately, and answers relying on it start failing.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

update_builtin_action_settings.title: Update a built-in action's settings
update_builtin_action_settings.description: Configure or disable one of CustomGPT's built-in actions for this agent, without touching the custom ones.

attributes.description: The settings for that built-in action, typically including `enabled`.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_labels.title: List an agent's labels
list_labels.description: Every label defined on an agent. Labels scope retrieval to a subset of the index, so one agent can answer different audiences from different documents.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_labels.title: Create labels
create_labels.description: Define one or more labels on an agent, ready to attach to documents and users.

attributes.description: The labels to create.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

assign_users_to_label.title: Assign users to a label
assign_users_to_label.description: Grant users access to the documents a label covers. This is the access-control half of labels -- it decides which documents a given user's questions can retrieve.

attributes.description: The label and the users to assign to it.

output.description: The record after the update.

get_label.title: Get a label
get_label.description: One label's details, including which users it has been assigned to.

output.description: The requested record.

update_label.title: Rename a label
update_label.description: Change a label's name. Its document and user assignments are unaffected.

attributes.description: The new label name.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_label.title: Delete a label
delete_label.description: Delete a label. Documents carrying it lose the scoping, so content that was restricted to one audience may become retrievable by everyone.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

remove_users_from_labels.title: Remove users from labels
remove_users_from_labels.description: Revoke users' access to labelled documents in bulk. The users keep their team membership; only the label-scoped retrieval goes.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

get_customer_intelligence.title: Get customer intelligence
get_customer_intelligence.description: CustomGPT's analysis of what users are actually asking one agent -- themes, gaps and unanswered questions. The report that says which documents the index is missing.

output.description: The requested record.

get_traffic_report.title: Get traffic analytics
get_traffic_report.description: Traffic to one agent over time -- sessions and volume, for sizing usage and spotting a drop.

output.description: The requested record.

get_queries_report.title: Get query analytics
get_queries_report.description: Query volume and outcome for one agent, including how often it answered versus failed to find an answer.

output.description: The requested record.

get_conversations_report.title: Get conversation analytics
get_conversations_report.description: Conversation-level analytics for one agent -- length, resolution and engagement, rather than per-query counts.

output.description: The requested record.

get_analysis_report.title: Get analytics chart data
get_analysis_report.description: The chart series behind the CustomGPT analytics dashboard, for rebuilding those views in your own reporting.

interval.description: Bucket size for the series, e.g. daily or weekly.

output.description: The requested record.

export_leads.title: Export leads
export_leads.description: The leads an agent captured through its lead form, with their contact details and the conversation each came from.

page.description: Which page of leads to return.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

export_conversation_leads.title: Export a conversation's leads
export_conversation_leads.description: The lead data captured in one specific conversation, rather than across the whole agent.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

export_collated_lead.title: Export a conversation's collated lead
export_collated_lead.description: One conversation's lead information collated into a single record, ready to push into a CRM.

session_id.description: The conversation's session id, from list_conversations.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

list_licenses.title: List an agent's licenses
list_licenses.description: The licenses issued for one agent. Licenses are how an agent is resold or distributed to end customers under separate keys.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_license.title: Create a license
create_license.description: Issue a new license for an agent, so a downstream customer can use it under their own key.

attributes.description: The license to create, e.g. its `name`.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_license.title: Get a license
get_license.description: One license's details, including its key and current status.

output.description: The requested record.

update_license.title: Update a license
update_license.description: Change a license's name or status. Deactivating one cuts off the downstream customer using it.

attributes.description: The license fields to change.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_license.title: Delete a license
delete_license.description: Delete a license. Whoever was using its key loses access to the agent immediately and irreversibly.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

get_current_user.title: Get the current user
get_current_user.description: The profile behind this API key, including which team is currently active. The cheapest call that proves the credential works.

output.description: The requested record.

update_current_user.title: Update the current user's profile
update_current_user.description: Change the authenticated user's own profile details -- name, and the notification preferences the account carries.

attributes.description: The profile fields to change.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

search_team_members.title: Search team members
search_team_members.description: Find team members by name or email, for resolving a person to the user id the team tools take.

q.description: The text to match against member names and emails.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

list_teams.title: List teams
list_teams.description: Every team the authenticated user belongs to. Most other calls act on whichever team is currently active.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

update_team_name.title: Update a team's name
update_team_name.description: Rename the active team. Cosmetic only -- membership, agents and roles are untouched by the change.

attributes.description: The new team name.

output.description: The record after the update.

switch_team.title: Switch the active team
switch_team.description: Change which team subsequent calls act on. Worth knowing: agents and reports are scoped to the active team, so a call that returns nothing may simply be pointed at the wrong one.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

list_team_members.title: List team members
list_team_members.description: The people in the active team, with the role each holds.

page.description: Which page of members to return.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

update_team_member_role.title: Change a team member's role
update_team_member_role.description: Set the role a team member holds. Raising someone to an administrative role gives them control over every agent in the team.

attributes.description: The new role for the member.

output.description: The record after the update.

remove_team_member.title: Remove a team member
remove_team_member.description: Remove someone from the team. They lose access to every agent in it; re-adding them means a fresh invitation.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_invitations.title: List pending invitations
list_invitations.description: Invitations that have been sent but not yet accepted, with the role each grants.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_invitation.title: Invite a new member
create_invitation.description: Invite someone to the team at a given role. They become a member only when they accept.

attributes.description: The invitation -- the invitee's `email` and the role they will hold.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

resend_invitation.title: Resend an invitation
resend_invitation.description: Send a pending invitation again, for the common case of an email that never arrived.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

cancel_invitation.title: Cancel an invitation
cancel_invitation.description: Revoke a pending invitation so its link stops working. Does nothing to someone who already joined.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_roles.title: List roles
list_roles.description: The roles available in the team, built-in and custom, with the permissions each carries.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_role.title: Create a custom role
create_role.description: Define a custom role with its own permission set, for granting narrower access than the built-in roles allow.

attributes.description: The role definition, including its name and permissions.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_role.title: Update a custom role
update_role.description: Change a custom role's permissions. Everyone holding the role is affected at once, so a narrowing change can cut off several people.

attributes.description: The role fields to change.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_role.title: Delete a custom role
